note: The originals of the demo pictures: real photographs from Wikimedia Commons, each in the public domain or under CC0, so they may be used, changed and passed on freely. Each was scaled down to at most 2400px on its long side and saved as JPEG (quality 85) without its metadata. tools/media.py builds project/assets/Media from them and writes CREDITS.md from this file.
